On a linkedinInMail step it is sent as plain text (LinkedIn does not render HTML), and a blank one is saved but blocks the campaign launch

On `linkedinInvite`: the premium invitation note attached to the connection request, used when the sending account has LinkedIn Premium. On `linkedinSend` and `linkedinVoiceNote`: the out-of-network note, sent as a connection request when the lead is not a 1st-degree connection. Rejected with `400` on any other step type. LinkedIn caps a connection-request note at 200 characters on a free account and 300 on Premium or Sales Navigator. This endpoint does not enforce those caps, but an over-long note is a blocking step error: the campaign refuses to launch until it is shortened

altMessagePremium.description: For `linkedinSend` steps only. The premium variant of the out-of-network note, sent instead of `altMessage` when the sending LinkedIn account is Premium or Sales Navigator (300-character LinkedIn cap). Rejected with `400` on any other step type

customName.description: The step's own name, shown instead of its type label ("Email", "Call") wherever the app names the step. Plain text, up to 70 characters once trimmed and once runs of spaces collapse to one; HTML tags count toward the 70, then are dropped. A longer name is rejected with `400`. Accepted on every step type, ignored on `conditional` steps, which keep their type label

title.description: Title of the task the step creates. Required on `manual` steps, optional on `phone` steps and on a channel step with `manual: true`. Maximum 100 characters

manual.description: Holds a channel step behind a task: `true` creates a task, named by `title` and ranked by `priority`, and the campaign sends the step once the task is marked done. A `linkedinVoiceNote` step also needs its recording, see [Manual steps](/api-reference/endpoints/sequences/add-step-to-sequence#manual-steps). Accepted on `email`, `linkedinInvite`, `linkedinSend`, `linkedinInMail`, `linkedinVoiceNote`, `whatsappMessage` and `sms` steps. Rejected with `400` on every other type, `manual` and `phone` steps included: they are always tasks

priority.description: Priority of the task the step creates: `0` low, `1` medium, `2` high. Omitted, the task has no priority. Accepted on `manual` and `phone` steps and on the channel steps that take `manual`, where it applies once the step is manual

url.description: URL of the API endpoint to call (required for api steps). Must start with http:// or https://

customField.description: For conditional steps keyed `customLeadInfo` only. The field to test. A bare name reads as a lead variable (`jobTitle` becomes `variables.jobTitle`); prefix with `fields.` to test a contact field. A company field is written `company.<field>` - `company.name`, or `company.sector` for a company custom field named `Sector` - and `companyName` or `variables.companyName` is stored as `company.name`. `$` and the reserved keys `_id`, `teamId`, `campaignId`, `leadId`, `__proto__`, `constructor` and `prototype` are refused.

customOperator.description: For conditional steps keyed `customLeadInfo` only. How the field is compared.

customValue.description: For conditional steps keyed `customLeadInfo` only. The value the field is compared to. Required for `equal` and `contains`, and refused for `empty` and `notEmpty`.

campaignId.description: Target campaign ID for sendToAnotherCampaign steps. The campaign must exist and not be archived

leadAction.description: Applies to `sendToAnotherCampaign` steps only. What happens to the lead in the SOURCE campaign once it has been moved to the target one. `continue` keeps it running the remaining steps, `pause` pauses it, `stop` ends the source campaign for it. Omitted leaves the step without a value, which behaves as `continue`; a step added from the lemlist UI defaults to `stop`. A transfer that fails always pauses the lead, whatever this says.

endLeadStatus.description: Applies to `endSequence` steps only. The status the lead shows once the step ends it. `completed` ends the lead; `interested` and `notInterested` end it and mark its interest, as marking it from lemlist does. Omitted stores `completed`.

images.description: Public HTTPS URLs of images to attach to a `linkedinInvite` or `linkedinSend` step. lemlist downloads each file and re-hosts it. Allowed MIME types: `image/png`, `image/jpeg`, `image/gif`. Up to 20 MB per file, and up to 6 items total combined with `videos`.

videos.description: Public HTTPS URLs of videos to attach to a `linkedinInvite` or `linkedinSend` step. lemlist downloads each file and re-hosts it. Allowed MIME types: `video/mp4`, `video/quicktime`. Up to 20 MB per file, and up to 6 items total combined with `images`.

skillName.description: Name of the LinkedIn skill to endorse on the lead's profile. Applies to `linkedinEndorse` steps only.

endorseAnyFallback.description: Applies to `linkedinEndorse` steps only. When `true` and the named skill is not on the lead's profile, lemlist falls back to endorsing any available skill.

recordMode.description: Applies to `linkedinVoiceNote` steps only. Determines how the audio is sourced. `manual` (default) means the user records the audio themselves from the lemlist UI after step creation; `ai` means lemlist generates the audio from a text template provided in the lemlist UI.

A lookup is charged only when it returns data. With both `find_email_01` and `verify_01`, only one runs for a lead: `verify_01` if it has a correctly formatted email, `find_email_01` otherwise. An unknown value or an empty array is rejected with `400`. `enrichment` steps need the Multichannel Expert plan or above

actions.name: list_contacts
actions.description:
Get Many Contacts. Retrieves contacts by IDs/emails or by CRM record ids, or searches/lists contacts by name, email, contact list, campaign membership, or company link.

When using `idsOrEmails`, returns an array of matching contacts directly.

When using `crmIds`, looks the contacts up by their record id in the connected CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive) and returns an array of the contacts found, each with the matched id under `crmSync.crmRecordId`. `idsOrEmails` takes precedence over `crmIds`; a lookup ignores the search filters and the pagination.

When using `search`, `email`, `listId`, `notInAnyCampaign`, any of the `company*` filters, or no filter at all, returns a paginated ...

idsOrEmails.description: A comma separated string of either valid contact IDs (MongoDB ObjectId) or valid email addresses. Optional — when omitted, returns the paginated list of all contacts of the team. Maximum 100 values.

crmIds.description: Comma-separated record ids of contacts in the CRM connected to the team (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive); for Salesforce, the 18-character Contact or Lead id. Returns an array of the contacts found, each with the matched id under `crmSync.crmRecordId`; ids that match nothing are skipped, and the array is empty when no CRM is connected. Duplicates are removed; an empty value is ignored. Maximum 100 values (`TOO_MANY_CRM_IDS`); a value over 25 characters answers `INVALID_CRM_ID`. Ignored when `idsOrEmails` is provided.

search.description: Search contacts by name or other text fields. Must be at least 2 characters.

email.description: Search contacts by exact email address.

listId.description: Filter contacts by contact list ID (`clt_xxx` format). Can be combined with `search` or `email`, or used alone to list all contacts in a list. Get valid IDs from `GET /contacts/lists`.

notInAnyCampaign.description: When set to `true`, only returns contacts that are not part of any campaign (orphan contacts). Can be used alone or combined with other filters such as `search`, `email`, or `listId`.

companyId.description: Filter contacts by attached company ID (`cpn_xxx` format). Use this when you already know the lemlist company id (for example after fetching `GET /companies?crmSyncStatus=unique_index_error_company`). Mutually exclusive with `companyDomain`, `companyLinkedinUrl`, and `companySalesnavUrl`.

companyDomain.description: Filter contacts by their company's website domain. Resolved to a `companyId` against the Companies collection. If no company matches, the endpoint returns an empty list (`total: 0`). Mutually exclusive with the other `company*` filters.

companyLinkedinUrl.description: Filter contacts by their company's LinkedIn URL. Resolved to a `companyId` against the Companies collection. If no company matches, the endpoint returns an empty list (`total: 0`). Mutually exclusive with the other `company*` filters.

companySalesnavUrl.description: Filter contacts by their company's LinkedIn Sales Navigator URL. Resolved to a `companyId` against the Companies collection. If no company matches, the endpoint returns an empty list (`total: 0`). Mutually exclusive with the other `company*` filters.

withPrimaryCompany.description: When set to `true`, only returns contacts linked to a company; when set to `false`, only returns contacts without a company. Omit for no filter. Mutually exclusive with the `company*` filters (`companyId`, `companyDomain`, `companyLinkedinUrl`, `companySalesnavUrl`).

fieldRejectionReason.description: Filter contacts to those carrying a field rejection with this reason — a value lemlist refused to write, prefixed by its origin (`enrichment_*` while enriching, `crm_sync_*` during CRM sync). Returns an empty list (`total: 0`) when no contact matches. Each returned contact exposes the full detail under `fieldRejections[]` (which field, why, and `conflictingRecordId` for duplicates). Only applies to the paginated list — ignored when `idsOrEmails` is provided (that path returns the exact contacts requested, unfiltered).

crmSyncStatus.description:
Filter contacts by their CRM sync state against the team's active CRM provider. Requires a CRM (Hubspot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive) to be connected — otherwise the request returns `400 NO_CRM_CONNECTED`. Values:
- `synced` — the contact has a CRM record and no sync errors.
- `not_synced` — the contact has no CRM record yet.
- `searching` — a CRM search (Search & connect, Create in CRM) is queued or running for the contact.
- `not_found` — the last CRM search found no record for the contact.
- `error` — at least one sync error is currently raised, whatever its reason.
- A specific error reason (lowercase form), to filter by root cause:
  - `invalid_email` — the CRM refused the contact's email.
  - `property_doesnt_exist` — a mapped property does not exist in the CRM.
  - `required_field_missing` — a field the CRM requires is missing.
  - `unique_index_error_contact` — the CRM record is already synced with another lemlist contact.
  - `contact_already_exists_with_name`, `contact_already_exists_with_linkedin_url`, `contact_already_exists_with_email` — a CRM contact already exists with the same first and last name, LinkedIn URL or email.
  - `contact_blocked_by_company` — contact not created: its company already exists in the CRM.
  - `contact_blocked_by_company_search` — contact not created: the company search is incomplete, retried later.
  - `contact_blocked_by_company_without_name` — contact not created: its company needs a name to be found in the CRM.
  - `contact_blocked_by_company_without_key` — contact not created: its company needs a domain or LinkedIn URL to be found in the CRM.
  - `contact_blocked_by_company_already_synced` — contact not created: its company is already synced with another lemlist company.

Only applies to the paginated list — ignored when `idsOrEmails` or `crmIds` is provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return (1–500). Defaults to 100.

offset.description: Number of contacts to skip for pagination. Defaults to 0.

If a contact with the same email, LinkedIn URL, or Sales Navigator URL already exists, it is updated as the `updateStrategy` query parameter says (by default, sent values replace stored ones and empty values are ignored). You can target an existing contact directly by providing `contactId`, bypassing email/LinkedIn matching. You can optionally link the contact to a company by providing `companyId`, `companyDomain`, or `companyLinkedinUrl`.

contactOwner.description: Owner of the contact. Can be a user ID (e.g. `usr_...`) or a team member's email address. Id of the record of the connected CRM to link the contact to: a HubSpot, Pipedrive or Zoho numeric id (send a Zoho id as a string: its 19 digits are too long for a JSON number), an Attio record id, or a Salesforce Contact (`003…`) or Lead (`00Q…`) id of 15 or 18 characters. actions.name: list_companies
actions.description:
Get Many Companies. Retrieves companies by IDs/domains or by CRM record ids, or lists them with filters.

When using `idsOrDomains`, returns the matching companies in `data`, with `total` and no pagination.

When using `crmIds`, looks the companies up by their record id in the connected CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive) and returns them like `idsOrDomains` does, each with the matched id under `crmSync.crmRecordId`.

Otherwise, returns a paginated response with `data`, `total`, `limit`, and `offset`.

`idsOrDomains` takes precedence over `crmIds`; a lookup ignores the list filters and the pagination.

idsOrDomains.description: Comma-separated list of company IDs or domains to fetch. When provided, returns only matching companies (no pagination). Each value is classified as a company ID (e.g. `cpn_xxx`) or a domain (e.g. `example.com`). URLs are normalized automatically (e.g. `https://example.com/path` → `example.com`). Invalid values are silently skipped. Maximum 100 values.

crmIds.description: Comma-separated record ids of companies in the CRM connected to the team (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive); for Salesforce, the 18-character Account id. Returns the companies found in `data`, with `total` and no pagination, each with the matched id under `crmSync.crmRecordId`; ids that match nothing are skipped, and `data` is empty when no CRM is connected. Duplicates are removed; an empty value is ignored. Maximum 100 values (`TOO_MANY_CRM_IDS`); a value over 25 characters answers `INVALID_CRM_ID`. Ignored when `idsOrDomains` is provided.

offset.description: Number of companies to skip for pagination. Defaults to 0. Ignored when `idsOrDomains` is provided.

sortBy.description: The field by which to sort. Currently, only 'createdAt' is supported.

sortOrder.description: The sort direction. Use 'desc' for descending order; any other value (or omission) will sort in ascending order.

fields.description: Returns selected fields. Returns all fields if empty. Each field is separated by a comma (e.g., '_id,fields.name,domain')

limit.description: Number of companies to retrieve. Default: 100. Maximum: 500

listId.description: Filter companies to the members of a CRM company list (`clt_xxx` format): a static list, or a dynamic list kept in sync with its filters. A legacy dynamic list, evaluated from its saved filters each time it is read, is rejected with `CRM_LIST_DYNAMIC`; both kinds of dynamic list show `dynamic: true` in `GET /companies/lists`. Combines with every other filter. Ignored when `idsOrDomains` is provided.

crmSyncStatus.description:
Filter companies by their CRM sync state against the team's active CRM provider. Requires a CRM (Hubspot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive) to be connected — otherwise the request returns `400 NO_CRM_CONNECTED`. Common values:
- `synced` — the company has a CRM record and no sync errors.
- `not_synced` — the company has no CRM record yet.
- `searching` — a CRM search (Search & connect, Create in CRM) is queued or running for the company.
- `not_found` — the last CRM search found no record for the company.
- `error` — at least one sync error is currently raised.
- A specific error reason (lowercase form), to filter by root cause: `unique_index_error_company`, `property_doesnt_exist`, `required_field_missing`, `company_already_exists_with_name`, `company_already_exists_with_linkedin_url`.

For each returned company, see `crmSync.errors[].metadata.alreadyExistingCompanyId` to identify the lemlist company that already occupies the conflicting CRM record (useful to remap contacts before deleting the duplicate).

fieldRejectionReason.description: Filter companies to those carrying a field rejection with this reason — a value lemlist refused to write, raised during CRM sync (`crm_sync_*`). Returns an empty list (`total: 0`) when no company matches. Each returned company exposes the full detail under `fieldRejections[]` (which field, why, and `conflictingRecordId` for duplicates). Independent of `crmSyncStatus` (which keys off the live provider errors); this filter reads the stored field rejections. Only applies to the paginated list — ignored when `idsOrDomains` is provided (that path returns the exact companies requested, unfiltered).

actions.name: upsert_company
actions.description:
Add and update company. Creates a new company or updates an existing one (upsert). If a company with the same domain, LinkedIn URL, or Sales Navigator URL already exists, it is updated as the `updateStrategy` query parameter says (by default, sent values replace stored ones and empty values are ignored). You can target an existing company directly by providing `companyId`, bypassing domain/LinkedIn matching, in which case `name` and the identifiers become optional. Without `companyId`, `name` is required together with at least one identifier: `domain`, `linkedinUrl` or `linkedinUrlSalesNav`.

actions.name: list_views
actions.description:
List Views. Lists the views of one list (the Contacts, Companies or Tasks page) as the API key's user sees them, in tab order: the lemlist default views, the views shared with the team and the user's private views. `pinned` flags the ones shown as tabs.

Each view carries its filters as the page saved them, plus a `url` that opens the page on that view.

actions.name: create_view
actions.description:
Create View. Creates a view on one list for the API key's user and pins it on their tabs.

Each condition is checked against [Get View Fields](/api-reference/endpoints/views/get-view-fields): an unknown field, an operator the field does not offer or a value it does not accept answers `400` with `ENTITY_VIEW_INVALID_FILTER`, and the message names the field and what it takes. Without `filters`, the view shows every record.

`visibility: "everyone"` shares the view with the team and needs the "Create views for the team" permission. A scope (the user's private views, the team's shared views) holds up to 200 views.

On a task view, `sort` and `columns` take the columns [Get View Fields](/api-r...

actions.name: get_view_fields
actions.description:
Get View Fields. Lists the fields a view of that list can filter on: the filters the page offers, the team's custom fields included, each with its type and operators. Fields the page only offers with a connected CRM are left out when the team has none.

`options` lists the values a field accepts when the page lists them (statuses, picklist values): send an option's `value`, not its `label`. On a user, list or campaign field, `options` holds only the special values (such as `__me__`, the user viewing the list) and the field also takes record ids.

actions.name: set_view_tabs
actions.description:
Set View Tabs. Sets the API key user's tabs on one list: the views in `pinned` show as tabs, in that order. Every other view is hidden from the tabs, not deleted, and stays in the views panel. Tabs are personal: other members keep theirs.

Every id must be one of the views the user sees on that list, default views included; a repeated id counts once.

actions.name: update_view
actions.description:
Update View. Renames a view, changes its icon or its visibility, or replaces its filters, sort or columns. Omitted fields keep their value.

`filters`, `sort` and `columns` each replace the current ones when sent, checked as on create. A sort saved from the lemlist extension may name a field that is not a column: [List Views](/api-reference/endpoints/views/list-views) returns it as is, `sort` left out keeps it, and sending it back answers `400`.

Default views (`isDefault: true`) are read-only: copy one with [Duplicate View](/api-reference/endpoints/views/duplicate-view) to change it. Editing a view shared with the team, or sharing one, needs the "Create views for the team" permission.

actions.name: delete_view
actions.description:
Delete View. Permanently deletes a view for everyone who sees it: a view shared with the team leaves every member's tabs. There is no undo.

Default views cannot be deleted: hide one from the tabs with [Set View Tabs](/api-reference/endpoints/views/set-view-tabs) instead. Deleting a view shared with the team needs the "Create views for the team" permission.
